{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Sound

|descr= Plays given song.

|s1= [class,start,volume] call [[BIS_fnc_playMusic]]

|p1= class: [[String]] - classname of song

|p2= start: [[Number]] - time of start in seconds - Default: 0

|p3= volume: [[Number]] - music volume from 0 to 1 - Default: [[musicVolume]]

|r1= [[Boolean]] - true

|x1= <sqf>["LeadTrack04_F", 10, 0.5] call BIS_fnc_playMusic; // song starts at 10 seconds with 50% volume.</sqf>
